properties.description:
Current MVP plan — reconciled 17 October 2026

Purpose
Make Broccoli usable for planning, inspecting, discussing, implementing and reviewing real work across TheBroccoli, BtrTemplate and PersoTemplate. The root MVP task owns the acceptance criteria. This planning iteration updates progress and remaining work; it records no human approval and starts no implementation.

Current location
Persistent planning and review MVP → Enable task and dependency editing directly in Task graph → Build a UI editor for progressive mockups in Review Changes → Review the UI editor inside the UI editor → Review generic web component previews — phase 1.
The component checks and Repositories work are iterations inside that review branch. They have not replaced the broader MVP sequence.

Implemented and verified in focused checks
• Shared Repositories composition in workspace and Review Changes: repository folders enriched with checks/components/models/systems, shared filters and saved queries, revision-aware detail selection, and latest structured check results. The independent result model does not depend on check implementations or UI.
• Generic component previews, Code/Visual/Preview, guarded source saves, public component properties represented as engine node types, and the regular Fields/Additional relations editor. Markdown accepts multiline input and remains empty when its input is empty. Preview dimensions, zoom, background pattern and boundary distinguish the viewport from component content.
• The latest recorded full component audits cover 93 components. Single-file, custom-element identity, no-argument construction, Lit inheritance and decorator checks pass for all 93. The concrete-element check passes across 463 inspected source files.
• The latest migration covers 21 components outside RelationalUi: 14 HarnessApp and seven DefaultSuperAppTemplate components. Elements was flattened into ordinary dependency levels and ComponentGallery removed. Repository selections now offer Node editor in workspace and Review.
• Final strict type validation: 1,016 authored sources, zero violations. The 12 focused UI-editor/repository-node browser tests pass; their screenshots were inspected.

Open work, not completion claims
• Visible-default audit: 48 pass and 45 fail. Of the failures, 42 are in RelationalUi and three are outside it (TemplateCreationDialogElement, RepositoryGraphElement, WorkPanelElement). Three was the scope of the last migration, not the repository-wide total. Empty Markdown and closed overlays must not gain artificial content merely to pass. The viewport is implemented, but its background does not constitute component paint. Reconcile each finding with the agreed component and viewport criteria before claiming compliance.
• Component property editing is implemented; generic component composition relationships and navigation in the repository bush still require end-to-end verification and any missing implementation. Repository file containment alone is not proof of component composition.
• The full checkpoint remains red: four planning/state/range/review failures remain after the removed-gallery model expectation was fixed and passed separately. One Chat Min/pane browser case failed in a combined run and passed in isolation; the cause is unresolved. No claim of a clean full browser suite or complete resolution of the earlier intermittent crashes is made.
• Repository filtering searches metadata. Searching file contents such as navigation-crumb is not implemented. Its scope is an open question for the existing later search task.
• Recorded human reviews remain outstanding. Implementation progress does not imply their acceptance.

Remaining current branch
Follow the existing review gates: finish the component-check review and its Repositories iterations → complete the component rework and remaining verification → visual review of the reworked components → finish/verify properties and composition navigation → integration review → phase-1 acceptance. Then the already planned phase 2 addresses authored sample data and substitutable services, with save/discard behavior decided before implementation and real data deferred until strict read-only guarantees exist. Finally review the editor using itself.

Return route after the UI editor
Resume the existing serial plan: review/annotation mockups and their review → review/annotation implementation and review → Task graph editing needs/proposal/implementation/review → delivery-plan review → task-completion persistence and refresh → navigation → measured performance → review correction workflow → earlier MVP acceptance → nested execution/review model → contributor-owned model/Systems inspection → buildspace durability/privacy → multi-repository Git/deployment workflow → search → creation entry points → result-history browsing → final MVP audit and human review.

Delivery rules
One focused implementation iteration and one human review at a time. Review corrections remain children of the relevant review. Existing prerequisite relations remain unchanged; this reconciliation does not bypass gates, change review outcomes, or reinterpret blocked tasks as unimplemented work. The frozen earlier plan is review evidence; this child is the current reconciliation requested by the user.

Current evidence
.harness/outside-ui-types-final.log
.harness/outside-ui-verified.log
.harness/outside-ui-checkpoint-stable.log
.harness/outside-ui-model-coverage-final.log
.harness/outside-ui-consumers-final.log
.harness/outside-ui-pane-isolation.log
.harness/component-checks/2026-10-16T22-34-01.484Z-empty-default/empty-default.json
The other latest audit directories are dated 16 October and named single-file, identity, construction, lit, decorators and element-interfaces.

This reconciliation is prepared for review. Its waiting placement follows the parent delivery-plan review's existing prerequisite; it does not mean the progress record has not been written.
